description: This Java class 'BreadcrumbsUtils' provides utility methods for building breadcrumb navigation structures for categories and products in a web application. It constructs breadcrumb trails based on category lineage, product details, and current store context, utilizing various services and utility classes.

classes.name: BreadcrumbsUtils
classes.description: A utility class for creating breadcrumb navigation data structures for categories and products within the e-commerce application.

methods.name: buildCategoryBreadcrumb
methods.description: Constructs a breadcrumb trail for a clicked category, including parent categories based on lineage, for display in the web UI.

methods.name: buildProductBreadcrumb
methods.description: Constructs a breadcrumb trail for a clicked product, including its category path, for display in the web UI.

methods.name: parseBreadCrumb
methods.description: Parses breadcrumb reference content to extract category IDs.

methods.name: parseCategoryLineage
methods.description: Splits a lineage string into individual category IDs.

methods.name: buildBreadCrumb
methods.description: Builds a breadcrumb string representation from a list of category IDs.
